stories.name_en: Acquisition of Cigna Business in Asian Markets
stories.explanation: Strategic acquisition of Cigna's accident and health and life insurance business in Asian markets in 2022
stories.signal: Strategic expansion into personal accident and supplemental health business
stories.description: Acquisition of Cigna's personal accident and supplemental health (A&H) and life insurance business in several Asian markets in 2022, advancing product and geographic diversification strategy

stories.name_en: Controlling Majority Interest in Huatai Insurance Group
stories.explanation: Acquisition of controlling majority interest in Huatai Insurance Group Co. Ltd, a Chinese financial services holding company
stories.signal: Strategic expansion into Chinese insurance market with property, casualty, life and asset management operations
stories.description: Achieved controlling majority interest in Huatai Group on July 1, 2023, with ownership interest at 87.2% as of December 31, 2025, advancing diversification with separate P&C, life, and asset management subsidiaries
